title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Java, Angular & Cloud Infrastructure)
description:
Senior Full Stack Engineer (Java, Angular \& Cloud Infrastructure)
 
 Location: Jaipur / Gift City, Gujarat, India Experience: 5\+ Years Employment Type: Full\-time
 


 Role Overview
 
 We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer who thrives at the intersection of robust backend services and scalable cloud infrastructure. You will be responsible for designing and implementing mission\-critical applications, ensuring that our technical architecture is as scalable as our business vision. We value clean code, automated infrastructure, and a “security\-first” mindset.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 * End\-to\-End Development: Design, develop, and maintain complex backend services using Java 17/21 and Spring Boot 3\.x.
* Frontend Excellence: Build responsive, high\-performance web interfaces using Angular (v17\+) and modern state management (RxJS/Signals).
* Infrastructure as Code: Own the cloud lifecycle by writing and maintaining Terraform scripts to manage AWS resources.
* Security \& Identity: Implement and manage secure authentication/authorization flows using OAuth2, JWT, and OpenID Connect (Keycloak).
* Database Management: Design schema and optimize queries for PostgreSQL or similar relational databases.
* Architecture \& Mentorship: Lead technical decisions, conduct rigorous code reviews, and ensure the team adheres to SOLID principles and design patterns.


 Technical RequirementsBackend (Java / J2EE / Spring Boot)
 * Deep expertise in Spring Boot 3\.x, Spring Security, and Spring Data JPA.
* Strong understanding of Microservices architecture and RESTful API design.
* Experience with build tools like Maven or Gradle and JVM tuning.
* Bonus: Experience with document processing libraries (Apache POI/iText) or Blockchain integration.


 Frontend (Angular)
 * Proficiency in TypeScript and Angular 17\+ (Standalone components, Reactive Forms).
* Solid grasp of RxJS for asynchronous stream handling.
* Experience with UI frameworks like Angular Material or Tailwind CSS.


 Cloud \& DevOps (AWS \& Terraform)
 * Hands\-on experience with AWS services: EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, and VPC.
* Proven ability to manage environments using Terraform (Modules, State management).
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI).


 General
 * Expertise in Git and version control workflows.
* Strong understanding of Docker and Containerization.
* Ability to write comprehensive unit and integration tests (JUnit, Mockito, Jasmine/Jest).


 What We Look For
 * Problem Solvers: You don’t just write code; you solve business problems with elegant technical solutions.
* Architectural Thinking: You understand the “why” behind technology choices, not just the “how.”
* Self\-Starters: You are comfortable working in an environment where you are expected to take ownership of a feature from conception to production.


 Why Join Us?
 * Opportunity to work on cutting\-edge financial technology/tokenization projects.
* A culture that values “Peace of Mind” and high\-quality engineering standards.
* Competitive compensation and the ability to influence the technical roadmap of the company.


 How to Apply
 * Please share your GitHub profile or portfolio of your recent work. Highlight a specific project where you managed both the application code and the underlying infrastructure.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 
 EarthRe is redefining reinsurance for the modern era by combining capital with intelligence through a proprietary platform that automates the underwriting lifecycle. The company transforms complex risk assessments into actionable deployments, working as an extension of clients’ teams to help risk move at the speed of their ambition. EarthRe delivers infrastructure for product innovation, enabling precision pricing and frictionless claims settlement. By turning static treaties into dynamic partnerships, EarthRe supports sustainable growth for its partners. As a strategic co\-pilot in reinsurance, EarthRe provides both capital and insight to guide decision\-making.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site role for a Full Stack Engineer based in Gandhinagar. The Full Stack Engineer will design, develop, and maintain web applications that power EarthRe’s proprietary platform, working across front\-end and back\-end systems. Daily responsibilities include implementing user interfaces, building APIs and services, optimizing application performance, and ensuring reliability and security. The role involves collaborating closely with product, data, and underwriting teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions and to support continuous platform improvements. The engineer will participate in code reviews, write tests, document features, and contribute to architecture decisions that enable scalable, resilient products.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Architect, build, and maintain secure, scalable backend services utilizing Python and Node.js.
* Design, develop, and document RESTful APIs and background services (including schedulers and containerized functions) to support high\-volume data ingestion, analytics, and complex product workflows.
* Develop and manage robust cloud infrastructure and deployments across GCP, AWS, and Firebase, ensuring high availability and optimal performance.
* Design and implement automation pipelines to streamline development workflows, continuous data processing, and application deployments.
* Architect and optimize relational and NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB) to effectively manage large\-scale datasets.
* Containerize applications and manage reliable deployments utilizing Docker.
* Facilitate seamless integration between React/Next.js frontend user interfaces and backend APIs.
* Develop responsive, intuitive, and high\-performance user interfaces using Next.js, React, and Tailwind CSS.
* Write clean, modular, and testable code while actively participating in code reviews and upholding engineering best practices.
* Investigate and resolve production issues across APIs, user interfaces, and cloud infrastructure, driving continuous improvements in system reliability.



  





**Must\-have Skills** 



* Strong proficiency in Python development.
* Proven experience with React and/or Next.js, alongside building responsive UIs with Tailwind CSS.
* Demonstrated expertise in building and consuming RESTful APIs, background services, event schedulers, and automation pipelines.
* Familiarity with Node.js for frontend tooling and server\-side integrations.
* Practical knowledge of cloud infrastructure with hands\-on experience deploying backend services on GCP, AWS, or Firebase.
* Proficiency with Docker and modern development workflows (Git, CI/CD pipelines).
* High Degree of Ownership: A proven track record of taking features from conception to production, navigating ambiguity independently, and taking full accountability for system outcomes.
* Exceptional problem\-solving skills and the agility to thrive in a fast\-paced startup environment.
* AI Tool Proficiency with Accountability: Extensive experience leveraging AI coding assistants, coupled with the critical ability to evaluate, comprehend, and take absolute ownership of generated code to ensure codebase integrity.



  





**Preferred Qualifications (Good\-to\-Have)** 



* Hands\-on experience developing and maintaining backend services using Go.
* Foundational understanding of the underlying mechanics of AI agents and Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Exposure to container orchestration and deployment management using Kubernetes

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
**Location:**

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time

 3–6 Years
 



  





**About Zignuts** 




 Zignuts is a global technology consulting and AI\-powered software engineering company delivering digital transformation solutions for startups, SMEs, and enterprises.
 



 Our engineering team builds scalable, secure, and intelligent digital products using modern software architectures, cloud technologies, and AI\-driven development practices.
 



 We are looking for an experienced Software Development Engineer who can build high\-quality applications while actively leveraging AI to improve engineering productivity, automation, and product capabilities.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As an
 **FullStack Developer** 
 , you will design, develop, integrate, and maintain scalable web applications using the
 **MERN Stack** 
 , while incorporating modern Generative AI and automation capabilities.
 



 You will work extensively with
 **MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js, and Next.js** 
 , along with AI technologies such as
 **LLMs, AI Agents, RAG, AI APIs, n8n, and AI\-assisted development tools** 
 .
 



 This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building products, solving complex technical problems, experimenting with emerging AI technologies, and continuously improving software engineering practices.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 Full\-Stack MERN Development
 


* Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using the MERN Stack.
* Build robust backend services and APIs using Node.js and Express.js.
* Develop modern, responsive frontend applications using React.js and Next.js.
* Implement Next.js features including SSR, SSG, routing, middleware, and API routes.
* Build reusable components, libraries, and scalable frontend architectures.
* Design and optimize MongoDB schemas, queries, indexes, and database structures.
* Work with MySQL and PostgreSQL where required.
* Implement caching mechanisms using Redis.
* Build real\-time applications using WebSockets and Socket.IO.
* Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and GraphQL services.
* Design and implement scalable microservices and backend architectures.



  





  





 AI \& GenAI Engineering
 


* Integrate Generative AI and LLM capabilities into modern web applications.
* Build AI\-powered features, assistants, copilots, and intelligent business solutions.
* Develop and integrate AI Agents and multi\-agent workflows.
* Work with RAG\-based applications, embeddings, vector databases, and prompt engineering.
* Integrate AI models and APIs into backend services and business workflows.
* Evaluate AI outputs and continuously improve accuracy, reliability, and performance.
* Explore emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities for AI\-driven product innovation.



  





  





 AI Automation \& Engineering Productivity
 


* Actively use AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot.
* Leverage AI tools for coding, debugging, testing, refactoring, documentation, and code reviews.
* Identify repetitive technical and business processes that can be automated using AI.
* Experiment with AI Agents and autonomous workflows to improve engineering and operational efficiency.
* Promote AI\-first engineering practices across development workflows.



  





  





 Application Architecture \& Performance
 


* Design scalable, maintainable, and secure application architectures.
* Optimize applications for performance, scalability, responsiveness, and reliability.
* Implement secure authentication, authorization, API security, and data protection practices.
* Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across frontend, backend, and database layers.
* Develop reusable components, services, and architectural patterns.
* Ensure cross\-browser compatibility and web accessibility standards.
* Participate in technical architecture and technology decisions.



  





  





 Cloud \& Deployment
 


* Work with cloud\-based application infrastructure, primarily AWS.
* Containerize applications using Docker.
* Work with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes.
* Manage Git\-based development workflows using Git and GitHub.
* Collaborate with DevOps teams to improve application reliability and scalability.
* Troubleshoot application and production issues across development, staging, and production environments.



  





  





 Engineering Collaboration \& Mentorship
 


* Collaborate with project managers, UI/UX designers, developers, architects, and clients.
* Translate business requirements into scalable and reliable technical solutions.
* Conduct and participate in code reviews and technical discussions.
* Mentor junior and mid\-level developers through code reviews, pair programming, and knowledge sharing.
* Support project teams during planning, development, and implementation.
* Foster a culture of ownership, quality, automation, and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate closely with engineering leadership on technical and product decisions.



  





  





 AI\-Driven Software Engineering (Mandatory)
 



 • Champion the use of AI in daily software development workflows.
 



 • Drive adoption of AI tools for:
 



 Code generation
 



 Debugging
 



 Testing
 



 Code review
 



 Documentation
 



 Refactoring
 



 Technical research
 



 Workflow automation
 



 Knowledge sharing
 



 • Continuously evaluate new AI tools, models, frameworks, and development approaches.
 



 • Identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity through AI\-assisted development.
 



  





**Technical Skills** 




 Must Have
 



  




* Strong experience with
 **MERN Stack development** 
 .
* Strong proficiency in
 **Node.js and Express.js** 
 .
* Strong experience with
 **React.js and Next.js** 
 .
* Strong knowledge of
 **MongoDB** 
 .
* Strong understanding of JavaScript (ES6\+) and TypeScript.
* Experience with RESTful APIs and/or GraphQL.
* Experience with scalable backend and frontend architecture.
* Experience with Git and GitHub.
* Experience with AWS or other cloud platforms.
* Experience with Docker.
* Understanding of microservices architecture.
* Experience integrating
 **GenAI / LLM APIs** 
 .
* Understanding of AI Agents, RAG, prompt engineering, or AI workflows.
* Hands\-on experience with AI development tools such as
 **Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude** 
 .



  





  





 Good to Have
 


* Experience with RAG and vector databases.
* Familiarity with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or similar AI frameworks.
* Experience with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or other LLM APIs.
* Redis and advanced caching strategies.

 We're looking for someone who:

 roles.
